meta.title: Deadlock Randomizer: Random Hero & Item Build Generator
meta.description: Roll a random Deadlock hero, a legal item build in purchase order, an ability point order and three bravery rules. Share the seed, reroll as often as you like.
meta.keywords: deadlock randomizer, deadlock random build, deadlock ultimate bravery, random hero deadlock, deadlock build generator

footer.credit: Heroes, items and artwork provided by <link>Deadlock API</link>.

gunslinger.label: Gunslinger
gunslinger.blurb: Most of your souls went into the gun. Win your trades with it before anyone has armour.

caster.label: Caster
caster.blurb: The roll is built around your abilities. Hold the cooldowns for the fight that matters.

bulwark.label: Bulwark
bulwark.blurb: You bought survivability first. Be the one who walks into the lane and does not leave.

exactOrder.title: Buy in order
exactOrder.detail: Purchase the build strictly top to bottom. No skipping ahead, even when you can afford the next tier. Upgrades come whenever you can pay for them.

noRecall.title: No base shopping after 15:00
noRecall.detail: Once the clock passes fifteen minutes, every purchase has to happen outside your own base.

parry.title: Always parry
parry.detail: Every melee swing thrown at you gets a parry attempt. Trading damage instead counts as a fail.

noZipline.title: Grounded
noZipline.detail: The zipline is off limits for the first ten minutes. Walk.

meleeOpening.title: Fists first
meleeOpening.detail: Until your first tier 2 item is bought, melee is your only way to damage an enemy player.

ultOnCooldown.title: Never bank the ultimate
ultOnCooldown.detail: Your ultimate goes out the moment it comes up. Saving it for a better moment is a fail.

noRetreat.title: No retreat
noRetreat.detail: Never leave a lane fight you started. You win it, or you walk back from the spawn.

soulCap.title: Spend it all
soulCap.detail: The moment you can afford the next item in your build, go buy it. Banking souls past its price is a fail.

oneLane.title: Lane loyalty
oneLane.detail: Stay in the lane you rolled until the first guardian on it falls. No rotations, no jungle.

noCancel.title: Commit
noCancel.detail: Every ability you start casting gets finished. Cancelling a cast is a fail.

callout.title: Call every roll
callout.detail: Type your hero, your lane and your first item in all chat before the barrier drops.

noHeal.title: Denied
noHeal.detail: Never heal up in your own base. Regen, lifesteal and healing items only.
